Configure current feature

  1. Use L_LoadTest with a declared matrix of clients/AI/resources/zones and exact hardware/build/network conditions. Begin with small populations and report measured limits rather than claiming MMO scale.
  2. Instrument server tick p50/p95, actor/channel count, bandwidth, packet loss, backend latency/locks, rejected stale epochs and command retry rates. Compare generic replication against one separately configured optimization candidate only.
  3. Prepare actual backup/restore, drain/restart, schema/content compatibility and secret-rotation runbooks in a disposable deployment.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Run gradually increasing independent clients/parties and multi-zone transfer/economy contention workload; stop at the recorded budget threshold.
  2. Kill source/target/service processes at defined transaction/handoff boundaries, restore and reconcile accepted receipts/ledger balances.
  3. Restore a database backup into isolated staging, verify character/item/economy checks and re-admit clients with fresh epochs.
  4. Attempt replay/ownership/rate/SQL-injection/speed forgery cases; review lag-induced false positives before sanctions.
Expected success
Publish actual measurements and failure boundary, not guessed concurrency. Restored acknowledged commits match receipts/ledger and no old writer resumes.
Use either Iris or Replication Graph for a candidate net driver, never both; generic baseline remains until measured improvement justifies migration.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. No measured numbers exist in this documentation edition. Regional/global scale requires subsequent benchmarks and capacity planning.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureOverbudget load triggers controlled admission rejection/drain, not silent data loss. Failed restore/migration blocks release.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Publish measured budgets and incident runbooks; do not substitute actor counts for real load tests.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
